risks.risk: Model mismatch (DGX-520 vs another Yamaha portable) leading to wrong pricing and wrong parts/compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model label/serial plate (usually on the underside/back) showing 'DGX-520' and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Yamaha portable keyboard (worst-case for value) until the exact model is confirmed.

risks.risk: Some keys may be dead or intermittent; buttons may not respond correctly.
risks.proof: Short video showing a full key sweep (left-to-right) with on-screen meter/voice change, plus a few button presses (e.g., sustain, volume, rhythm/voice).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully functional (worst-case) until a complete test is shown.

risks.proof: Photo of the exact adapter with its output specs (V/A) and a close-up showing it matches the keyboard’s power requirement.
risks.if_unproven: Price as adapter not included (worst-case) until confirmed.

risks.risk: Hidden damage not visible from this angle (cracked casing, loose keybed, damaged display/speakers).
risks.proof: Photos of the underside, both ends, and a close-up of the display/speaker area; plus a quick power-on video showing the screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically acceptable but potentially needing service (worst-case) until power-on and close-ups are provided.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the underside/back model label showing 'DGX-520' and serial number.
Video test: press every key (or at least a full range sweep) and show no dead keys; include button presses.
Photo of the adapter/power cable and its output rating; confirm it powers the keyboard.
Power-on video showing the display working and a short audio demo to confirm no crackle.
response.reason: The photo confirms a Yamaha portable keyboard, but the exact DGX-520 model and key/button functionality (and whether the adapter is included) are not verifiable from the single image. Missing these details prevents confident worst-case pricing.
